newsitem.title: UK: Guardian down as SBC Warburg rates "reduce".
newsitem.headline: Guardian down as SBC Warburg rates "reduce".

text.p: General Accident Plc rose on Thursday as SBC Warburg upgraded the stock while Guardian Royal Exchange Plc dropped as the brokerage rated it "reduce," dealers said.
Analysts at SBC Warburg raised General Accident to "buy" from "add" and also raised Royal Sun Alliance Plc to "buy" from "add."
Also in the composite insurance sector, Warburg stayed negative on Guardian Royal and on Commercial Union Plc, which was rated "take profits," market sources said.

Shares in General Accident were up 6p at 812 by 1017 GMT, against the declining trend of the market overall. Royal Sun was down 4-1/2p at 447-1/2, Guardian was down 10p at 283 and CU was down 5-1/2p at 672-1/2.

Sources said Warburg analysts argued that General Accident had been oversold in recent sessions, having dropped eight percent from its peak earlier this year, and that on the basis of an enterprise valuation it was the cheapest in the sector.
On Royal Sun the brokerage argued that a prospective share buyback could see demand from the company for up to 400 million stg of its stock.
